trailhead.label: The bus-stop car park in Cogolo, the board’s start

cautions: About 50 m along the pavement of the SP87 in Cogolo at the start: keep your dog on a short lead.
The Plaze lane is also a cycle path: watch for bikes.
Cows may graze on the meadows below the church in summer.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.About 50 m along the pavement of the SP8: Circa 50 m sul marciapiede della SP87 a Cogolo alla partenza: tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.The Plaze lane is also a cycle path: wat: La strada per le Plaze è anche ciclabile: attenzione alle bici.
textIt.Cows may graze on the meadows below the: In estate le mucche possono pascolare sui prati sotto la chiesa.
